## SF10 v-next.8 - Outreach Drafts (standalone)
Owner-triggered. Modes: generate (step-1 drafts for approved leads, deterministic gates, pending_audit), regen (one corrective pass for regen_pending failures), sweep (similarity gate over a batch). DRAFTS ONLY - no send node exists. Export = SF10X. Design: sf10/DESIGN.md v4 (Wonder READY TO BUILD).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO outreach_suppression (company_id, person_key, reason, created_by)
SELECT (r->>'company_id')::uuid, NULLIF(r->>'person_key',''), r->>'reason', $2
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) r
ON CONFLICT (company_id, person_key, reason) DO NOTHING
RETURNING company_id

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM cost_ledger WHERE workflow = 'SF10' AND event_type = 'charge' AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS day_calls,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM cost_ledger WHERE workflow = 'SF10' AND event_type = 'charge' AND created_at >= date_trunc('week', now())) AS week_calls

WITH prof AS (SELECT profile FROM search_profiles WHERE id = $1 AND version = $2),
fields AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(profile->'research_fields') AS f FROM prof)
SELECT c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.category, c.location,
       c.email AS company_email, c.facebook_url, s.fit_score,
       a.decided_at AS approval_at,
       ev.evidence_quote, ev.evidence_url, ev.observed_at,
       p.id AS person_id, p.full_name AS person_name, p.title AS person_title,
       p.email AS person_email,
       (c.id::text || '|' || COALESCE(p.full_name, '')) AS person_key,
       CASE
         WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email_status = 'verified'
              AND p.email !~* '^(info|contact|admin|hello|support|sales)@'
           THEN 'email'
         WHEN c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '' THEN 'email'
         WHEN c.facebook_url IS NOT NULL AND c.facebook_url <> '' THEN 'messenger'
       END AS channel,
       CASE
         WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email_status = 'verified'
              AND p.email !~* '^(info|contact|admin|hello|support|sales)@'
           THEN 'person'
         ELSE 'business'
       END AS addressee,
       CASE
         WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email_status = 'verified'
              AND p.email !~* '^(info|contact|admin|hello|support|sales)@'
           THEN 'verified direct email of decision-maker'
         WHEN c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '' THEN 'company email (generic route)'
         ELSE 'facebook page (business route)'
       END AS targeting_reason
FROM companies c
JOIN scores s ON s.company_id = c.id AND s.search_profile_id = $1 AND s.profile_version = $2
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT decision, decided_at FROM approvals
  WHERE company_id = c.id ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON a.decision = 'approved' AND a.decided_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ra.value->>'evidence_quote' AS evidence_quote,
         COALESCE(ra.value->>'evidence_url', ra.source_url) AS evidence_url,
         COALESCE((ra.value->>'observed_at')::timestamptz, ra.created_at) AS observed_at
  FROM research_artifacts ra
  WHERE ra.company_id = c.id
    AND ra.field_name IN (SELECT f FROM fields)
    AND ra.value->>'evidence_quote' IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE((ra.value->>'observed_at')::timestamptz, ra.created_at) >= now() - interval '30 days'
  ORDER BY COALESCE((ra.value->>'observed_at')::timestamptz, ra.created_at) DESC
  LIMIT 1
) ev ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT pp.* FROM people pp
  WHERE pp.company_id = c.id AND pp.is_decision_maker = true
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_suppression sx
                    WHERE sx.company_id = c.id
                      AND sx.person_key = (c.id::text || '|' || pp.full_name))
  ORDER BY (pp.source = 'tavily_xray') DESC, pp.created_at
  LIMIT 1
) p ON true
WHERE c.search_profile_id = $1
  AND c.quarantined_at IS NULL
  AND s.fit_score >= $3
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_suppression sx WHERE sx.company_id = c.id AND sx.person_key IS NULL)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_drafts d WHERE d.company_id = c.id AND d.step = 1)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_failures f WHERE f.company_id = c.id AND f.review_status = 'manual_queue')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_claims cl WHERE cl.company_id = c.id AND cl.claimed_at >= now() - interval '2 hours')
  AND (p.email IS NOT NULL OR (c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '') OR (c.facebook_url IS NOT NULL AND c.facebook_url <> ''))
ORDER BY s.fit_score DESC
LIMIT 30

INSERT INTO outreach_claims (company_id, run_id, profile_id)
SELECT (r)::uuid, $2, $3::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) r
ON CONFLICT (company_id) DO UPDATE SET run_id = EXCLUDED.run_id, profile_id = EXCLUDED.profile_id, claimed_at = now()
RETURNING company_id

parameters.query:
UPDATE outreach_failures f SET review_status = 'manual_queue'
WHERE f.profile_id = $1 AND f.review_status = 'regen_pending'
  AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach_suppression sx WHERE sx.company_id = f.company_id AND sx.person_key IS NULL)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companies c WHERE c.id = f.company_id AND c.quarantined_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals a WHERE a.company_id = f.company_id AND a.decision = 'approved'
                   AND a.decided_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
                   AND a.decided_at = (SELECT max(a2.decided_at) FROM approvals a2 WHERE a2.company_id = f.company_id))
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scores sc WHERE sc.company_id = f.company_id AND sc.search_profile_id = $1 AND sc.fit_score >= $2)
  )
RETURNING f.id

SELECT f.id AS failure_id, f.company_id, f.reason_codes, c.name AS company_name,
       c.category, c.location, c.email AS company_email, c.facebook_url
FROM outreach_failures f
JOIN companies c ON c.id = f.company_id
WHERE f.profile_id = $1 AND f.review_status = 'regen_pending'
ORDER BY f.created_at
LIMIT 10

WITH prof AS (SELECT profile FROM search_profiles WHERE id = $1 AND version = $2),
fields AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(profile->'research_fields') AS f FROM prof)
SELECT $4::uuid AS failure_id, $5 AS reason_codes, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.category, c.location,
       ev.evidence_quote, ev.evidence_url, ev.observed_at,
       p.id AS person_id, p.full_name AS person_name, p.title AS person_title,
       p.email AS person_email,
       (c.id::text || '|' || COALESCE(p.full_name, '')) AS person_key,
       CASE
         WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email_status = 'verified'
              AND p.email !~* '^(info|contact|admin|hello|support|sales)@' THEN 'email'
         WHEN c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '' THEN 'email'
         ELSE 'messenger' END AS channel,
       CASE
         WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email_status = 'verified'
              AND p.email !~* '^(info|contact|admin|hello|support|sales)@' THEN 'person'
         ELSE 'business' END AS addressee,
       CASE
         WHEN p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email_status = 'verified'
              AND p.email !~* '^(info|contact|admin|hello|support|sales)@' THEN 'verified direct email of decision-maker'
         WHEN c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '' THEN 'company email (generic route)'
         ELSE 'facebook page (business route)' END AS targeting_reason
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ra.value->>'evidence_quote' AS evidence_quote,
         COALESCE(ra.value->>'evidence_url', ra.source_url) AS evidence_url,
         COALESCE((ra.value->>'observed_at')::timestamptz, ra.created_at) AS observed_at
  FROM research_artifacts ra
  WHERE ra.company_id = c.id AND ra.field_name IN (SELECT f FROM fields)
    AND ra.value->>'evidence_quote' IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE((ra.value->>'observed_at')::timestamptz, ra.created_at) >= now() - interval '30 days'
  ORDER BY COALESCE((ra.value->>'observed_at')::timestamptz, ra.created_at) DESC LIMIT 1
) ev ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT pp.* FROM people pp WHERE pp.company_id = c.id AND pp.is_decision_maker = true
  ORDER BY (pp.source = 'tavily_xray') DESC, pp.created_at LIMIT 1
) p ON true
WHERE c.id = $3

parameters.query:
SELECT d.id AS draft_id, d.company_id, d.body, d.created_at, 'batch' AS kind,
       c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(p.full_name, '') AS person_name, d.evidence_quote
FROM outreach_drafts d
JOIN companies c ON c.id = d.company_id
LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id = d.person_id
WHERE d.run_id = $1 AND d.status = 'pending_audit'
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id, d.company_id, d.body, d.created_at, 'pool',
       c.name, COALESCE(p.full_name, ''), d.evidence_quote
FROM outreach_drafts d
JOIN companies c ON c.id = d.company_id
LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id = d.person_id
WHERE d.profile_id = $2 AND d.run_id <> $1 AND d.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND d.status IN ('pending_audit', 'audited', 'exported')

WITH del AS (
  DELETE FROM outreach_drafts
  WHERE id IN (SELECT (r->>'draft_id')::uuid FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) r)
  RETURNING id, company_id, run_id, profile_id
)
INSERT INTO outreach_failures (run_id, profile_id, company_id, reason_codes, body_text, output_hash, cost_usd, review_status)
SELECT d.run_id, d.profile_id, d.company_id, ARRAY['similarity'], r->>'body', md5(r->>'body'), 0, 'manual_queue'
FROM del d
JOIN jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) r ON (r->>'draft_id')::uuid = d.id
RETURNING id

parameters.jsCode: const s = $('Similarity Sweep').first().json; return [{ json: { success: true, stage: 'SF10', mode: 'sweep', batch_size: s.batch_size, similarity_rejected: s.rejected } }];
const c = $('Config Gate').first().json; return [{ json: { success: false, stage: 'SF10', stop_reason: c.stop_reason, mode: c.mode } }];
